pages.text: With $(l)Timeless and Classics Zero (TacZ)$() installed, cats with $(l)Cat Armory$() can equip firearms on a back-mounted turret harness!$(br2)Switch to $(l)Tactical Mode$() so your cat engages enemies from range using real TacZ ballistics, magazine reloads, and ammo from its Ammo Pouch or Kitty Pack.

pages.title: Gunsmith Job
pages.text: Assign a cat with the $(l)Gunsmith Paw$() talent to the $(l)Gunsmith$() job near a TacZ Gun Smith Table.$(br2)- $(l)Level 10+$(): Crafts TacZ ammunition.$(br)- $(l)Level 25+$(): Crafts TacZ attachments.$(br)- Place a template item in the cat's offhand to specify which ammo or attachment to craft!
